title: Learned Adaptive Multiresolution Diffusion Imaging
summary: Adaptive multiresolution methods reduce representation cost by concentrating fine-scale degrees of freedom where needed, but their tree updates are usually governed by fixed local criteria. We introduce Learned Adaptive Multiresolution Diffusion Imaging (Learned AMDI), which preserves the AMDI fixed-tree propagator and hierarchy constraints while replacing the post-propagation selector with a shared local policy trained by proximal policy optimization.
